remainingContactEntry:
# New-contact entry after navigation ownership

Observed implementation, not an activation claim:

- PrepareCollaborationSpaceConversation reads the complete bounded128 active setup inventory,
  then canonical metadata by peer. Existing originals and canonical references are reusable under
  owned local access. Creating an original requires currently admitted discovery. It performs no
  HTTP/SDK dispatch and reconciles an uncertain local insertion by that exact original ID.
- ObserveCollaborationSpaceConversationCommands exposes owned local original facts. Its existing
  contract alone is not a current Group directory gate or permission to show content.
- CollaborationDraft and EditCollaborationSpaceDraft require a canonical conversationId. The
  latter reads canonical metadata and publishes the draft and inbox atomically. Replacing that ID
  with peerAccountId or setup-command ID violates the accepted contract.
- EncryptedCollaborationDraftRepository commits the source draft and ready inbox through exactly
  two raw partition mutations. It shares authenticated content-key ownership, but importing a new
  peer draft must not silently enlarge the raw two-partition transaction bound.

Next design and implement a distinct peer-addressed working draft with encrypted source ownership,
compare-and-set revisions, empty revision tombstones, bounded indexing, account/Group revocation,
and process-reopen evidence. Keep it separate from a sent command. The user may compose before
current discovery is available. Setup submission retains one original and waits on its durable
result; it must not create another original after a lost response or retry UI recomposition.

Canonical handoff must conserve both text and intent across competing writers and process death.
Do not overwrite an existing canonical draft. A two-stage acknowledged copy can retain the source
until the destination has proved the same revision/body; reconciliation must recognize exact
replay and surface competing text for review. Never delete the peer source before destination
publication. A new contact row needs explicit peer identity rather than a fake conversation ID;
review bounded inbox merging before exposing pending new conversations there.

The entry ViewModel owns screen state and calls domain operations. Domain owns local admission,
original selection, bounded reconciliation and handoff policy. Repository coordinates raw storage;
no repository-to-repository dependency, UI scope in storage, or ViewModel provisioning helpers.
Actual phone/network/first-frame acceptance remains separate from host fixtures.
remainingGroupEntry:
# Product entry integration remaining after stable stack owners

HomeChatPage already supplies swipeable Conversations/Contacts slots and the scroll-aware FAB.
Reuse those slots. Group contact/inbox entries now take the same SpaceChatRoot, and the canonical
thread route takes that root as well. AppNavigation still resolves AppViewModel before its current
Company ScopedNavHost. Keep that window-level model at the same owner when adding any outer stack.

A Group stack may wrap a root destination that renders the existing Company subtree; its identity
must include the admitted account/Group lifetime, not the selected Company. Its root owner must
still close outgoing graphs/effects before a replacement is usable. Avoid putting window state
into the outer destination's ViewModelStore. Tests must exercise actual root/company composition,
rapid Back, a Company change while a Group thread is open, account replacement, root denial, and
process restoration under mismatched ownership before activation.

Observed gap: ObserveLocalCollaborationSpace emits null while acquiring a root, after a missing
root, or when its account/admission stream completes. Null is not a server feature-disabled fact.
There is currently no Group/legacy chat rollout decision in AppBuild or app composition. An
explicit rollout input must choose the legacy or Group experience; a Group denial/unknown root
must never silently select legacy Company chat. Do not add HTTP requests to composition to guess
that mode. This requires an explicit application integration decision, not an inferred fallback.

New-contact draft/original storage and canonical handoff remain described separately. Full company
filtering also still lacks complete memberships beyond the8 public labels; a visible filter must
not silently exclude omitted memberships. None of these product entries is activated by this
navigation ownership change. Phone92/live GroupOFF remain.
